newsitem.title: CHINA: China nabs woman in $6 million fraud scandal.
newsitem.headline: China nabs woman in $6 million fraud scandal.

text.p: Chinese police have arrested a woman for allegedly defrauding a bank and depositors of 50 million yuan ($6 million) with promises of paying high interest rates on loans, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Zhou Mingrong, 29, who had posed as deputy director of a credit cooperative in Jingzhou city in the central province of Hubei, was arrested in Zhanjiang city in the southern province of Guangdong this month, Xinhua said.
Several other suspects were also in police custody, it said.
Police began investigations after receiving complaints from more than 40 victims, including the Jingzhou branch of the People's Construction Bank of China, Xinhua said.
Two employees of the bank gave Zhou 2.55 million yuan in early April, lured by her pledge to pay them higher-than-market interest rates, the news agency said. Zhou disappeared soon after.
